reuse.why: The change extends the existing recurrence and weekend helpers, although getUpcomingDates repeats the shared daily-skipping predicate.

duplication.why: Holiday matching and date movement are shared, but the daily-skipping eligibility check is duplicated in the server handler.

placement.why: Most policy stays in shared/schedules.ts, while server handlers retain policy-dependent lookahead calculations that would fit better alongside it.

scope.why: All edits directly support daily skipping, date-range enumeration, holidays, or their integration and tests.

maintainability.why: Shared holiday handling is clear, but separate lookahead formulas and the requirement to pair skipping with adjustment spread scheduling-policy knowledge across consumers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getUpcomingDates computes config.skipWeekend && config.frequency === 'daily' independently of shared/schedules.ts:isWeekendOccurrenceSkipped.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated daily-skipping predicate is explicit; holiday matching and movement are shared rather than disguised copies.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains frequency and holidays options; applyWeekendRule gains a daily-schedule exception, and getUpcomingDates independently recomputes daily-skipping eligibility.
